I think it would be a great idea to add a membership feature, allowing for monthly or weekly subscriptions tailored to each AI role model. For instance, a membership for the "Flare" role model could be priced at 70k, while a membership for the most expensive role model, "Stella," might be around 150k. I believe this would improve the user experience by reducing the need for frequent top-ups and encouraging players to stay engaged longer—all without disrupting the narrative flow that often happens when players are forced to switch AI role models just to save money. For example, I might prefer using "Flare," but if my budget doesn't allow for constant top-ups, I’m forced to switch to "Spark," which ends up ruining the story. I hope you’ll consider this suggestion. Essentially, the pricing for monthly or weekly memberships should simply be adjusted based on the specific AI role model. (수정됨)
2026년 10월 21일 수요일 오후 10:48

Thanks for the suggestion!
Right now Frontia doesn't offer subscription plans, and all Star products are one-time purchases.
What you're really looking for is a way to keep enjoying your story with the AI model you love, without worrying about your budget and without the story getting disrupted because you had to switch models.
We feel the same way. A story you're enjoying shouldn't get cut off halfway, and we're thinking through and trying out different ways to make that happen.
Thanks for sharing your experience so clearly! — Sion, Team Frontia
